application_for_notice_of_Expulsion_of_a.title: application for notice of Expulsion of a partner

sections.value: e.g., NOTICE OF EXPULSION PURSUANT TO ARTICLE 12, OF THE PARTNERSHIP AGREEMENT

value: e.g., NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, that as a result of a meeting held by all the partners, we have agreed to expel you as a partner, pursuant to article 12 of the partnership agreement.
